about: Puslinch is a township in Wellington County, Ontario, immediately south of Guelph along Highway 401—not Guelph itself. Hamlets such as Aberfoyle and Morriston, kettle lakes, and estate-and-farm countryside define this rural township at the region’s southern door. About 8,000 people live in Puslinch Township.
